<section class="home-intro" aria-label="Profile">
  <h2>Seokju Kang</h2>

  <figure class="profile-card">
    <img src="assets/profile.jpeg" alt="Seokju Kang" />
  </figure>

  <p>Hi, I'm Seokju! I am a Ph.D. student in Management Engineering at UNIST (Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology), advised by Prof. Hyun Jin Jang. I received my B.S. in Industrial Engineering from Pusan National University.</p>

  <p>My research domain is in Financial Engineering with a particular emphasis on derivatives pricing, risk management, and quantitative methods in finance. More recently, I have been exploring how deep learning and reinforcement learning can advance these areas.</p>
